anacorp-ana-corp:lever:361a0567-8af7-401.title: Technical Service Specialist
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:361a0567-8af7-401.description: About ANA: Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, MAC3 Pneumatic Air tools, and ANA’s exclusive Energy Boss ™ - Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with locations in Cypress, California, and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling, and we are seeking a Technical Service Specialist to join our growing team in an onsite position at the Spartanburg, South Carolina, location. The Technical Service Specialist serves all external and internal customers by receiving inbound calls and emails while providing technical support consisting of technical troubleshooting, tracking calls, and developing new processes and procedures to assist customers as needed. The Technical Service Specialist role provides repair and maintenance help, along with warranty assistance to customers. A Technical Service Specialist will assist the parts department with part identification and preparation of parts that need service setup prior to shipment from the warehouse and customer use. A Technical Service Specialist is an excellent problem solver, an expert multitasker, and is process oriented. The Technical Service Specialist is a good teacher who instills confidence in customers internally as well as externally through phone and email support. The role requires a customer first attitude that is trustworthy, kind, and can maintain a positive attitude in the face of angry and frustrated customers. The Technical Service Specialist has excellent computer skills and understands diesel engines, electrical generators, and air compressors. This position is fully onsite and follows a Monday–Friday schedule from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with hours subject to change based on business needs. You will occasionally travel up to 5% in local domestic travel. This role reports to the Warranty & Technical Service Supervisor.
responsibilities: Make ANA Customers' World Easier
Answer inbound telephone calls, emails, and texts, helping resolve customer service and support issues
Research technical issues with the help of internal and external resources
Use a computer and multiple engine and controller software programs to provide technical support and standard computer skills, administrative, and trackability work
Develop new service processes as needed
Communicate technical information in easy-to-understand language
Assist all company departments with technical assistance for ANA products and accessories
Maintain the customer warranty system
Prepare parts that need Service Set-up before use by the customer
Occasional travel to locations to perform service work and conduct training on generators and air compressors
Be available for afterhours call coverage on a predetermined schedule
Track customer calls (all service contacts in the appropriate system for accurate record-keeping)
Elevate problems to management appropriately
Answer Support phone line (Primary)
Manage Support@anacorp.com email account (Primary)
Service customers’ equipment on site as needed (including equipment brought to ANA)
qualifications: Mechanical specialty training or equivalent hands-on work experience required
Trade school certification with a focus on engines or mechanical systems preferred
Working knowledge of generator controllers
Experience with generators and air compressors
Ability to read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams
OSHA 10 certification preferred
Proficient in the safe use of a digital multimeter
Strong electrical troubleshooting skills, including circuit diagnostics

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:93.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. We're looking for a Head of Marketing Operations to serve as the operational backbone of the marketing organization. This person will own budget, hiring operations, cross-team coordination, and the marketing tech stack, while working closely with the CMO on executive presentations, readouts, and the day-to-day priorities that keep the marketing organization running smoothly. This is a highly cross-functional role suited to someone who thrives on structure, enjoys translating ambiguity into clear process, and can build trust across a diverse set of stakeholders (creative, demand gen, product marketing, comms, etc.) as well as with senior leadership. WHAT YOU'LL DO Budget & Financial Operations - Own and manage the marketing department's budget end to end, tracking spend against plan, flagging variances, and partnering with Finance on forecasting and reporting - Build visibility into spend by team/channel/program so leadership can make informed tradeoffs - Support quarterly and annual budget planning cycles Hiring Operations - Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads to manage headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview logistics - Help standardize hiring processes across marketing sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards) - Keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design Cross-Functional Coordination & Executive Partnership - Bring together the different functions within marketing (brand, demand gen, product marketing, comms, etc.) for regular tactical updates and team-wide readouts - Own the cadence, agenda, and follow-through for marketing leadership meetings and all-hands - Partner directly with the CMO on presentation development, including board decks, executive readouts, and strategy docs, ensuring materials are polished, data-backed, and on-message Marketing Technology & Tools Oversight - Own visibility and oversight into all tools and platforms marketing is evaluating or onboarding over the next 12 months - Manage vendor evaluations, procurement conversations, and onboarding/rollout plans for new tools - Maintain a master view of the marketing tech stack, including licensing, usage, and renewal timelines WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 10 + years of experience in marketing operations, business operations, or a similar role supporting a senior marketing leaders - Strong financial acumen, comfortable owning a budget and communicating spend clearly to executives - Experience with hiring/recruiting operations, ideally partnering closely with TA teams - Excellent presentation and communication skills; experience building exec-level decks - Familiarity with common marketing tech stack tools (e.g., marketing automation, analytics, project management platforms) - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating across ambiguity - A collaborative operator who can build trust across a wide range of stakeholders, from individual contributors to the C-suite This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability 🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave 🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays 🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only) 📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend 🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment 🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only) 🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings ☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only) Want to learn more about what we are up to? - Meet the Replit Agent https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IYiVPrxY8-Y - Replit: Make an app for that https://www.yo

distro-distro:lever:9de6f3d1-acfe-48de-9.description: We are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you. About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting www.vensure.com . Position Summary The Service Operations Supervisor is responsible for managing client relationships, ensuring the seamless delivery of services, and supporting payroll and tax-related processes. This role involves coordinating user setup and training, facilitating client retention strategies, and acting as a liaison between clients and internal operations. The Service Consultant will also oversee payroll processing, analyze data for process improvements, and provide guidance on tax and reporting requirements. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Act as the primary contact for assigned group of clients. Coordinate user set-up and provide training for client-facing web-based payroll, custom reporting software and service platforms. Facilitate proactive intervention steps for at-risk clients, collaborating with internal teams, clients, and business consultants for successful retention. Manage client accounts by establishing and reinforcing strong relationships with clients, internal partners, brokers, and peers through proactive touch points and service recommendations. Act as a liaison between clients and internal operations to ensure seamless delivery of services in line with department SOPs. Coordinate and lead client meetings to review and discuss escalated issues or significant matters related to the client’s account. Identify gaps in client processed and introduce new products and services based on identified client needs. Manage and escalate client issues through various communication platforms, including submitting cases in Client Space to internal departments for resolution. Determine and recommend annual increases and/or reductions to client’s administrative fees. Assist with client tax account registration guidance, provide education on payroll tax questions, and obtain clients' tax account login credentials when entering a new state. Manage and escalate payroll tax notices and drive them to resolution. Assist and provide guidance with required state and federal reporting. Ensure timely and accurate payroll processing. Review processed payrolls and resolve payroll errors and issues; assist the team as needed. Monitor the work of Payroll Specialists who input payroll data and ensure payroll accuracy. Assist in payroll calculations and deductions. Maintain clear and consistent client communications. Work with the Quality Control Team to process current and prior year voids and resolve posted payroll errors. Analyze payroll problems and provide appropriate resolutions. Facilitate frequent communication regarding Payroll Associates and Service Associates performance, recommend training areas, and assist with coaching employees. Collaborate with the Manager to implement changes, provide feedback on team performance, and escalate client issues. Schedule and facilitate weekly POD team huddles to discuss client escalations and learning opportunities. Regular attendance at the assigned work location for our corporate office locations is an essential job function. For team members who are located in or near Chandler, AZ or Duluth, GA offices, this is an in-office position Marginal Functions Build, maintain and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines,

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:91c0149b-323.title: Sales Enablement Trainer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:91c0149b-323.description: Wing Assistant is hiring a hands on Sales Enablement Trainer to level up our sales team — not with generic intro decks, but by improving the actual emails, calls, and cadences our reps use every day. This is a coach who has carried a quota and closed, and uses that credibility to make real, measurable improvements on the floor. If your first instinct when a deal stalls is "let me see the thread and the call recording" — read on.
responsibilities: Sit in the calls — live and recorded — and find exactly where deals are being lost.
Rewrite the copy, scripts, and sequences that aren't converting, and prove the new version works.
A/B test sales emails, call openers, demo pitches, and tactics like personalized video — keep the winners, kill the losers.
Build and tune outbound cadences so reps follow up at the right time, on the right channel, with the right message.
Coach reps one-on-one on real calls and build the objection-handling playbook for our market — then drill it until it's reflexive.
Produce a video training series and self-serve modules with assessments, so new reps ramp fast and tenured reps keep sharpening.
qualifications: You'll thrive here if you
Have personally sold and closed — ideally outbound/high-volume B2B — and can show your numbers.
Write sales copy that converts and can explain  why  it works.
Are comfortable on camera and can produce clean training videos without a production team.
Can structure an A/B test, read the result honestly, and make the call.
Coach without crushing — you leave reps better and more confident.
Move fast: a diagnosis becomes a usable fix in hours, not weeks.
Know your way around a CRM (Hubspot plus) and a sales sequencing tool.
Nice to have

Experience in virtual staffing, BPO, or managed services · Pipedrive or CRM automations · video editing · sequencing tools (Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, Instantly, Smartlead) · prior sales enablement assets (playbooks, battle cards, certification programs).

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7013bd97-3836-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in Spain. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Investigate changes in product, marketing, and business KPIs, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. Conduct user behavior, funnel, retention, cohort, and segmentation analyses to understand product performance and customer behavior. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments, including A/B tests, CUPED/CUPAC methodologies, and the use of proxy metrics. Quantify the expected and actual impact of product and marketing initiatives and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, and other business teams to support data-driven decision-making and influence roadmap priorities. Generate actionable insights that help improve product performance, customer engagement, retention, and business outcomes. Work with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements, improve data quality, and strengthen the reliability of analytical datasets. Contribute to analytics infrastructure, dashboards, reporting processes, and metric systems to make insights more accessible and consistent. Help establish analytical standards, best practices, and reliable definitions for key product and marketing metrics. Support marketing and growth analytics, including LTV, CAC, attribution, funnel measurement, performance analysis, and optimization. Develop and validate leading indicators and proxy metrics that enable faster and more informed business decisions. Gradually take ownership of larger cross-functional analytical projects and drive them independently from definition through delivery. Mentor and support junior analysts, sharing analytical expertise and helping strengthen team capabilities. Participate in analytical planning and prioritization while developing stronger stakeholder management and communication skills with senior business leaders. Progressively take responsibility for analytical processes, quality standards, and team performance as preparation for a Product Analytics Team Lead position. Requirements Strong professional experience in Product Analytics, with a track record of using data to influence product and business decisions. Advanced SQL and strong data analysis capabilities. Hands-on experience with product metrics, funnels, retention, cohort analysis, experimentation, and growth analytics. Strong business and product thinking, with the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial and strategic outcomes. Ability to translate complex datasets and analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence collaborating across Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and senior leadership. Strong ownership mindset, independence, and the ability to take analytical projects from problem definition through implementation and impact measurement. Genuine interest in me

jobgether-jobgether:lever:740d5cbd-db44-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Netherlands. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b56f8e3e-5bdd-.title: Software Engineer, Trustus
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b56f8e3e-5bdd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Trust based in the United States. This role sits within a mission-driven Trust organization focused on protecting users from fraudulent listings and harmful experiences. You will build scalable systems that detect bad actors, prevent fraud, and reduce financial losses while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Working alongside machine learning engineers, data scientists, product managers, designers, and operations teams, you will tackle complex problems across the full technology stack. Your work will combine backend engineering, automation, machine learning integrations, and user-facing safeguards. The environment rewards curiosity, technical depth, and the ability to identify opportunities with significant business and customer impact. This is an opportunity to help make a global platform safer and more trustworthy at scale. Build and operate large-scale backend systems that detect fraudulent activity, using rules, productionized machine learning models, APIs, and high-volume data pipelines. Investigate end-to-end systems to understand how fraudulent listings are created, where vulnerabilities exist, and how bad actors can be detected or prevented. Partner with machine learning engineers, data scientists, product managers, designers, research teams, and customer service operations to identify, refine, prioritize, and deliver high-impact fraud prevention initiatives. Develop tooling and automation that enables operations teams to investigate and mitigate fraudulent activity more efficiently and consistently. Design and implement user challenges and verification mechanisms that prevent fraudulent listings while minimizing disruption to legitimate users. Build and improve data pipelines and supporting infrastructure for machine learning and fraud detection systems. Contribute to initiatives such as location verification, automated fraud investigations, operational tooling, and large-scale fraud mitigation. Write high-performance, production-quality code and contribute to scalable architectural solutions for complex trust and risk challenges. Communicate technical concepts, risks, and proposed solutions effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including operations and legal partners. Continuously identify opportunities where engineering solutions can meaningfully reduce fraud, financial losses, and negative customer experiences. Requirements: Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating systems at scale; relevant master's or PhD experience may also be considered. Demonstrate a strong passion for building user-facing products, robust backend services, or other high-scale software systems. Have professional experience with one or more relevant programming languages or frameworks, such as Ruby/Ruby on Rails, Java, JavaScript, Python, or Scala. Be capable of writing efficient, reliable, maintainable, production-quality code. Understand architectural patterns for large-scale web applications, including well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, scalable services, and efficient algorithms. Be comfortable working across disciplines and collaborating closely with product, design, data science, machine learning, research, and operations teams. Demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear discussions with non-technical stakeholders. Bring strong curiosity and analytical problem-solving skills, particularly when investigating complex systems and identifying sources of fraud or abuse. Experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, risk management, or a related domain is a plus. Be comfortable operating in an environment where priorities evolve and where engineers are expected to take ownership of meaningful, ambiguous problems. Benefits: Base salary: $162,000–$186,000

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:8edf10dd-5a6b-433a.title: Content Production Manager - Leaply
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:8edf10dd-5a6b-433a.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Що варто знати про Leaply? Leaply будує екосистему цифрових продуктів, щоб здоровий спосіб життя став можливим «на автопілоті». Наша місія — зробити Healthy Living новим золотим стандартом. Ми не продаємо теорію — ми створюємо найзахопливішу health-гру. Щодня — одна проста практика (дихання, масаж чи вправа), яка реально змінює самопочуття. Маленький крок кожного дня — відчутна трансформація з часом. Traction: - Запуск у червні 2024, юніт-економіку знайшли менш ніж за 2 тижні - 200K+ користувачів по всьому світу - 4.7 в App Store · 4.4 на Trustpilot (20 000+ відгуків) Команда: 60+ спеціалістів за 2 роки, remote-friendly. Амбіція на 3 роки — мільйони людей, які щодня роблять хоча б одну практику з Leaply. Стрімко масштабуємося на ринках США, Європи та LATAM. У Leaply ми цінуємо ownership більше за посади, а вплив — більше за процеси. Зараз, у період масштабування, ми шукаємо AI Content Manager, який визначатиме, як наш контент створюється, виробляється та масштабується в межах продукту. ПРО РОЛЬ У нашому бізнесі контент — це і є продукт: структуровані плани практик, відео- та аудіосесії і щоденні нагадування допомагають користувачам сформувати корисні сталі звички. На позиції Content Production Manager ти відповідатимеш за те, як цей контент реально створюється — від брифу до готового матеріалу — у всіх форматах і мовах, якими ми працюємо. Ти тісно співпрацюватимеш із продакт-менеджерами, дизайнерами та інженерами з найперших етапів роботи над фічею, а не отримуватимеш готовий бриф на фінальній стадії. Це роль про володіння процесом і продакшном: ти будуватимеш системи, воркфлоу та стандарти якості, які дозволяють команді перетворювати ідеї на послідовний контент у масштабі. ТЕХНОЛОГІЧНИЙ СТЕК - Notion і Slack для комунікації, колаборації та управління задачами - Наша внутрішня система управління контентом - Amplitude та Tableau для продуктової аналітики - Інструменти для планування та трекінгу продакшну (Jira, Confluence, Google Sheets, Figma або подібні) ОСНОВНІ ОБОВ'ЯЗКИ - Контент-продакшн end-to-end. Керувати повним циклом виробництва — від брифу до готового матеріалу — для структурованих планів практик, відеосесій, аудіоконтенту та in-app копірайтингу. Координувати внутрішню команду та зовнішніх підрядників (райтерів, войсовер-акторів, відеомонтажерів, перекладачів), щоб усе рухалося за графіком. - Робота з експертами. Залучати та координувати профільних експертів (лікарів, тренерів, коучів, фахівців з формування звичок та інших доменних спеціалістів) для перевірки контенту на достовірність і практичну цінність. Формувати брифи для експертної рецензії, збирати їхній фідбек і інтегрувати його в контент-план, а також підтримувати пул експертів для регулярної співпраці замість пошуку "з нуля" під кожен проєкт. - Кросфункціональна робота над продуктом. Працювати разом із продакт-менеджерами, дизайнерами та інженерами над фічами, які залежать від контенту, і долучатися до їхнього формування ще на етапі ідеї — а не отримувати вже фінальний бриф. - Координація кількох проєктів одночасно. Керувати кількома контент-проєктами паралельно, пріоритизувати задачі за умов конкуруючих дедлайнів і тримати всіх стейкхолдерів у курсі статусів і таймла

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. Location: Russell Speeders Car Wash (Farmington 1) 362 Scott Swamp Rd, Farmington, CT, USA 06032
